applicant_utility.summary: This award cannot be applied for directly: you apply to JWU under Early Action, and only applicants who meet the criteria are invited in January to compete through the Admissions Portal, which makes the Early Action 2 application-complete date the real deadline. The prize is tuition only - fees, housing, meals and flights stay with you - so a full-tuition win still leaves a substantial bill at a private U.S. university. Because JWU's live scholarships page no longer lists this award while the EducationUSA listing still describes it, confirm the scheme's survival with JWU Admissions before building your financing plan around it.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-U.S. citizen first-year undergraduates with strong transcripts and a documented record of extracurricular, volunteer or entrepreneurial leadership who can complete everything by the Early Action 2 deadline.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the JWU undergraduate application under Early Action 1 or Early Action 2 and make it fully complete well before the Early Action 2 deadline (January 4 in the 2026 cycle)
Watch the JWU Admissions Portal for the January scholarship invitation - the competition only opens to invited applicants
Prepare a Global Impact Statement that evidences concrete leadership through extracurricular, volunteer or entrepreneurial activity
Line up two letters of recommendation early, since they must accompany the scholarship submission
Verify with JWU Admissions that the award is still offered for your entry year before relying on it
common_rejection_risks: Applying under Regular Decision or another plan after the Early Action window - invitation eligibility flows from Early Action
An incomplete undergraduate application at the Early Action 2 cut-off, which ends scholarship consideration
Writing a Global Impact Statement that claims leadership without specific, evidenced activity
Assuming you can apply for the scholarship yourself instead of waiting for the portal invitation
Budgeting as if full tuition meant full cost of attendance - fees, room, board and living costs are not in the published scope
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The published scope is full tuition only; university fees, housing, meals, health insurance, books and international travel remain the student's responsibility, alongside visa costs.
document_audit: The Global Impact Statement is the centrepiece document and is read by a faculty and staff committee - treat it as the main competition, not a formality
Two letters of recommendation are required, so give referees enough lead time before the January scholarship round
Everything runs through the JWU Admissions Portal, including the invitation response - keep portal access and notifications active
alerts: The scholarship deadline differs from the admission deadline: admission must be complete by Early Action 2, but the scholarship round itself opens only by invitation in January
The award is available only at the Providence and Charlotte campuses
JWU's current scholarships page does not list this award even though the EducationUSA listing still describes it - treat future-cycle availability as unconfirmed
Even without this award, all full-time undergraduates are automatically considered for JWU merit scholarships by GPA band, so an Early Action application still carries funding value
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Early Action admission application first, portal invitation in January, then the Global Impact Statement and two recommendations submitted through the Admissions Portal for committee review.
